When this Mini World Change is active, a wandering orc camp appears in one of three places on the continent. Clear the orcs from the camp to make {creature:Bibby Bloodbath} appear and kill her to earn the achievement **Bibby's Bloodbath**.
A wandering orc encampment appears on the Tibian mainland.
Camp north of the Jakundaf Desert (one of the possible locations)
The Mini World Change has to be active that day.
Health potions and normal hunting equipment
You can only kill Bibby every **24 hours**. If you visit her again before the cooldown ends, it **resets**: only go up the camp stairs once 24 hours have passed since the last encounter.

When it is active, one of these messages appears: *"Bibby Bloodbath and her crew are roaming the lands, destroying everything in their path."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! Bibby is back with blood as her track! Wreaking havoc on her path, let her feel your wrath!"*.
The {wiki:Orc Encampment} appears in one of these three locations. Go and see which one is active.
All three locations are on the surface (floor 7), so you can simply walk from the nearest city. Use the table to choose the route and check the active location's coordinates on the map.

The desert is **west of Venore** and **south of Kazordoon**. Leave Venore to the west (or Kazordoon to the south) and look for the encampment in the northern part of the desert, at {coord:32671,32049,7}.
Leave Carlin and head **north** to {coord:32341,31731,7}; the encampment is close to the city.
The Femor Hills are **east of Carlin** and **north of Kazordoon**. Cross the hills eastwards from Carlin (or go north from Kazordoon) to {coord:32622,31827,7}.
Encampment: east of the Femor Hills

In the Femor Hills there are {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, {creature:Cyclops} and some {creature:Hunter|Hunters}; in the Jakundaf Desert there are {creature:Lion|Lions} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}. Nothing dangerous from the recommended level.

Kill all the orcs in the encampment: some {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} outside the palisade and, inside, two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, an {creature:Orc Leader} and three {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}.
The {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords} hit hard: pull them one at a time if you are a low level.
When all the orcs inside the encampment are dead, {creature:Bibby Bloodbath} appears. Kill her to receive the achievement **Bibby's Bloodbath**.

The encampment has no teleport or special exit: if you went up the stairs to reach {creature:Bibby Bloodbath}, go down the same stairs, leave through the palisade and walk back the same way to the city you started from (Venore/Kazordoon, Carlin or Kazordoon/Carlin, depending on the location).
Do not go back up the camp stairs before 24 hours have passed since your last encounter with Bibby, or the cooldown resets.
